title: IQ4_XS hybrid-offload and active-context frontier
purpose: Measure the speed, memory, and practical-context tradeoff between the existing full-GPU IQ2 configuration and a higher-bit IQ4_XS configuration that requires hybrid CPU/GPU placement on this 12GB GPU.
research_questions: What is the largest practical IQ4_XS GPU-layer request that retains at least 1024 MiB sampled VRAM headroom at 4K context?
How does the selected hybrid IQ4_XS configuration compare with the existing full-GPU IQ2 baseline under the identical Phase 4 decode workload?
How much memory does Q4_0 target K/V cache save relative to Q8_0, and does it materially change throughput or objective long-context behavior?
Which active prompt lengths, rather than configured context capacities, complete reliably at 16K, 32K, and 64K?
Does draft-mtp improve CPU-bound IQ4_XS decode under matched off/on controls, and are outputs equivalent?
primary_hypotheses: IQ4_XS will require partial GPU offload because its 14.627 GiB artifact exceeds physical VRAM before K/V and compute buffers are included.
Hybrid IQ4_XS will decode more slowly than full-GPU IQ2 but may improve selected objective quality outcomes.
Q4_0 target K/V cache will enable larger active contexts with a possible long-context quality cost.
MTP speedup will depend on draft-token acceptance and will not be assumed to preserve output.

included: IQ4_XS artifact preflight and checksum validation
Q8_0 versus Q4_0 target K/V cache
excluded: Treating community RTX 4060, RTX 3090, RTX 4090, RTX 5090, DGX, or MLX measurements as baselines for this PC
Claiming that configured context capacity proves active-prompt usability
Changing llama.cpp version during a controlled pair

stage_order.name: artifact and storage preflight
stage_order.exit_condition: Pinned artifact identity, storage safety, checksum, and clean-Git exclusions pass.

stage_order.name: 4K practical offload frontier
stage_order.method: Probe ascending GPU-layer requests from 25, then refine the first practical/non-practical bracket. Each probe uses Q8_0 K/V, MTP off, a fresh process, one short request, and captured startup evidence.
stage_order.practical_gate: Healthy startup, successful request, requested placement evidenced in the startup log, and at least 1024 MiB GPU memory free after the probe.

stage_order.name: matched 4K performance baseline
stage_order.method: Run one excluded warm-up and three measured 256-token repetitions using the Phase 4 prompt, first at the selected IQ4_XS placement and then compare against existing canonical IQ2 evidence.

stage_order.name: target K/V cache comparison
stage_order.method: Compare Q8_0 and Q4_0 K/V at fixed model, layer placement, prompt, seed, and context before extending context.

stage_order.name: active-context ladder
stage_order.method: Test approximately 78% active prompts at 16K, 32K, and 64K with explicit output reservation; retain failures and paging evidence.

stage_order.name: MTP and quality validation
stage_order.method: Run matched MTP off/on prose and code workloads, acceptance accounting, output hashes, and objective long-context retrieval checks.

measurement_rules.primary_performance_metric: mean server generation tokens per second

claim_boundaries: The 4K frontier is local to this GPU driver, WDDM state, runtime build, quant, and cache type.
Cross-hardware community numbers are context, not a combined benchmark table unless their protocols become comparable.
A 64K result may be reported only when the actual prompt token count is near the configured limit and the request completes with retained memory and latency evidence.
Any observed IQ4_XS quality advantage remains limited to the committed tasks.
exit_condition: Every completed stage has pinned inputs, machine-readable evidence, a bounded interpretation, and documented failures; public text distinguishes full-GPU IQ2 from hybrid IQ4_XS and configured context from active prompt length.
